Why it matters: Vercel bundles ESM functions with esbuild, and that breaks
NestJS — its dependency injection relies on emitDecoratorMetadata and
runtime reflection that does not survive bundling. A .cjs file would also
be CommonJS but Vercel does not detect .cjs as a Serverless Function.
